subject: Writing lines into a text file

messages.author: 6d516dae6aab4320
messages.subject: Writing lines into a text file
parts:
Hi,

I'm creating a summary file for the output of the script I'm working on. I want to be able to write the following line (for example) into a text file, or at least to be able to write all the parameters I specified inside the function I used :
ac.data <- subset(r.data, subject != 99 & rt > 100 & rt < 2000)  # Accuracy
Does anyone know what is the right function for that?

Thanks,
Ayala

messages.author: 689775b4b587052d
messages.subject: Re: Writing lines into a text file
parts:
Try

cat("ac.data <- subset(r.data, subject != 99 & rt > 100 & rt < 2000)", file = "test.txt", append = TRUE)

Thank you for your answer. Anyway this is not so critical for me, but if there was a simple way to do that it could have been nice.

messages.author: a305e65fa9dfb74d
messages.subject: Re: [Israel RUG] Writing lines into a text file
parts:
I would say that is exactly what R Markdown and knitr are intended to do.

If you want to do it manually, I would wrap the subset function with your own function, and then use some combo of match.call()  and capture.output().
